newsitem.title: USA: Mobil, Ca. refinery fire out, most units operate.
newsitem.headline: Mobil, Ca. refinery fire out, most units operate.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Friday that the fire at its Torrance, California refinery was extinguished at 0700 PDT/1400 GMT and most units at the plant were operating normally.

The fire affected a PTR unit, used to upgrade gasoline from low-octane to high-octane, and a Mobil spokesman could not immediately say by how much the incident had reduced the refinery's overall operating level.
The Torrance plant has capacity to process 130,000 barrels of crude oil a day. Its reforming unit has a 35,000 barrels a day capacity.
The fire broke out at the PTR unit at 0515 PDT/1215 GMT. There were not injuries and there was not threat to the community at any time, Mobil said in a statement.

The local population was notified but the unit does not involve toxic or hazardous chemicals. "Air monitoring is ongoing in the area to ensure that there is not potential of toxic exposure," Mobil said.
The cause of the incident had not yet been determined and is under investigation, Mobil said.
